author: Techno Tim
description:
Can a 10 year-old GTX 1080 still run useful local AI? I wanted to find out, so I put my old 8GB graphics card back to work in my old gaming machine as a homelab AI agent.

Using llama.cpp and GitHub Copilot CLI, I tested three Qwen models, from 2B all the way up to 35B. I gave each model the same task, deploying a service to a remote server in my homelab and verifying that everything worked.

In this video, I'll walk through the hardware, software, and models I tested, along with demos and the results. I definitely didn't expect it to work this good and definitely didn't expect this model to win.

Video Notes: https://technotim.com/posts/gtx-1080-local-ai-agent/
